title: チケゾー配達日記～学園編～

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! Tickezo's Delivery Service is open for business!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Remember how I delivered stuff in that game? The villagers really appreciated it, so I wanted to try it at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'll deliver everyone's precious cargo and fill their hearts with joy! What do you think?!
choice_data_list: Sounds like great training. I'll help!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Tickezo, you'll really deliver this package for me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I sure will! You just focus on your scrimmage, Yuki! So I'm taking this to a store in the shopping mall, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes, please! One nice worker down there has done a lot for my sense of style! So I wanted to gift them a little someth'n…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, but don't worry about it if they seem busy! I'm not even sure someth'n I picked would be to their liking…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why would you think that way? Being treated nicely made you happy, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: There's nothing to worry about! Not when this gift is chock full of appreciation!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That shop clerk will surely, no, definitely like your gift! I'll make sure to deliver your feelings as well, Yuki!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh my golly gosh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You serious? All right, bet. You can just drop it off or whatever. Turns out she's hanging around nearby.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, so it's for your mom? Wait, is this a birthday present?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, like, you could say that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wow, that's great! And it's been wrapped so nicely!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: N-not really. I just, like, grabbed some paper and slapped it on.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No waaay! You wrapped the gift yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Now it makes sense why it's so pretty. You must love your mom so much!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Don't you worry! I'll deliver this gift along with all of your precious feelings!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gah! It's not even like that! Geez, you're such a handful, Tickezo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So these cat-shaped cookie cutters… are from Hayahide? Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh my god, Taishin! That smile is exactly what Hayahide wanted to see!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. There you go again. I bet she just bought these on a whim.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Hayahide wanted to make you happy, so she must've spent ages picking these out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Stop exaggerating. I'm telling you it was no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ohh, I'm so glad that Hayahide's feelings reached you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Both she and I absolutely adore that incredibly precious smile of yours!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …! A-are you some kind of idiot?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you mad about? Taishiiin, talk to me!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Hey, did you hear?! Yeah, it turns out…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumors about Winning Ticket's escapades spread throughout the academy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm totally charged to make a bunch more deliveries today! But…

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: You hear about Tickezo's Delivery Service?! Every delivery comes with a heap of love! I don't think my heart could take it…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: …Well, I get the feeling there are a lot more eyes on me than usual.
choice_data_list: It means your service is the real deal!
I sort of get how they feel…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Are you saying that… everyone thinks my service is amazing?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Now I get it! Ehehe, then I've got to work even harder to make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, and listen to this, Trainer! I came up with a slogan to put my customers at ease!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Your package and feelings are safe with me! Tickezo's Delivery Service—a service you can rely on! What do you think?!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Swoon!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Fantastic! Everyone seems to love it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Y-you do?! But I don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, mind telling me what you're feeling? If it's unpleasant, then I'll—

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, n-no, it's nothing bad! It just makes our hearts throb!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Your hearts throb?! Then that's…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Just like the Derby! My heart pounds like crazy just thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unsurprisingly, Winning Ticket hasn't understood their feelings in the slightest.
